QUOTE: Three server errors are the exception. If the server returns `DELETED_ROOT_POST_ERROR`, `TOWN_SQUARE_READ_ONLY_ERROR` or `PLUGIN_DISMISSED_POST_ERROR`, the post is deleted locally instead of kept as failed.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names all three server errors (deleted root post, read-only town square, plugin-dismissed post) and says the post is deleted rather than kept.
